battery_mechanism.battery_role_explanation: Treatment pre-charges battery early at Cycle 00 and block-charges at Cycles 17-19 to 91.8% SOC, enabling generator shutdown during Cycles 20-23 and reducing diesel operating hours from 9 to 8.

soc_reconciliation.reconciliation_verdict: Both ranges represent genuine min-max SOC boundaries experienced during the 24 MPC cycles. The notation 21.5% -> 80.4% represents min-to-max range (21.5% min, 80.4% max), not initial-to-final SOC.

causal_chain.step_1_forecast: Stage 8.1 ML forecast provided lower daytime solar (-48.03 W/m2 mean signed diff, MAE 78.16 vs 137.80 W/m2).
causal_chain.step_2_optimizer_anticipation: Optimizer at Cycle 00 and Cycles 17-19 foresaw lower solar availability and high evening load.
causal_chain.step_3_block_charging: Optimizer dispatched high-power diesel block-charging (42.8 kW at C0, 63.3-75.8 kW at C17-18).
causal_chain.step_4_soc_trajectory: Battery SOC reached 91.79% at C20 (vs Control min 21.54% at C5 and gradual charging).
causal_chain.step_5_operating_hours: Treatment shut OFF generator for Cycles 20-23 (4 consecutive hours), reducing total generator ON hours from 9 to 8.
causal_chain.step_6_fuel_accounting: Saving 1 generator ON hour reduced fixed base fuel by -5.000 L, while producing +4.011 kWh generation added +1.003 L marginal fuel.
causal_chain.step_7_net_result: Net fuel consumption difference = -5.000 L + 1.003 L = -3.997 Liters (-3.19%).

unsupported_claims: Stage8.1 universally reduces diesel fuel by 3.19%
Stage8.1 guarantees real-world station fuel savings at Nuolja
Stage8.1 ML forecast is superior solely because it achieved lower operational fuel consumption
conclusion: The -3.997 L diesel fuel reduction in Treatment is fully reconciled by the reduction of 1 diesel generator operating hour (8h vs 9h), enabled by Stage 8.1 ML forecast driven battery pre-charging and block-charging, saving 5.0 L of fixed base overhead fuel.
